description: This file contains startup and reboot functions for the ESP32 SoC, including CPU initialization, system restart, and hardware reset routines, specifically for the app CPU in a Zephyr-based environment.

methods.name: __app_cpu_start
methods.description: Initializes the app CPU, sets exception vector, zeroes BSS, disables interrupts, and starts Zephyr kernel.

methods.name: arch_printk_char_out
methods.description: Default printk handler for outputting characters, can be overridden.

methods.name: sys_arch_reboot
methods.description: Reboots the system by calling esp_restart_noos.

methods.name: esp_restart_noos
methods.description: Performs a system restart by disabling interrupts, resetting cores, flushing UART, disabling cache, resetting peripherals, and halting.
